findings.problem: Missing exhaustive test for the futures-to-avoid list of an ALTERNATIVE on a REWRITE parent. The range is the window limit (at most 10 entries, Future 1 kept) and distinctness against Future 1. The test claims to prove 'at most 10 entries' and 'no duplicate run', but every case builds only 1-2 eligible runs, so `isLessThanOrEqualTo(10)` and the distinct check can never fail. The new `coalesce(p.scenario_run_id, p.id)` lookup makes the scenario run the 'parent' that `AvoidedFutures` always keeps when it trims `others` to MAX-1. No test covers the case where the scenario run is the oldest of more than 10 eligible runs on the pack: there Future 1 must still be the scenario run, the list must have exactly 10 entries and no rewrite may appear. The spec rule 'the distinctness check compares with that scenario' (ALTERNATIVE_NOT_DISTINCT when the candidate repeats the scenario run's causal steps or title, for a REWRITE parent) is not exercised either.
findings.fix: Add a case that seeds 11 or more COMPLETED runs with final_attempt on the same session and pack, all created after the scenario run, then rewrites the oldest one and starts an ALTERNATIVE on the rewrite. Assert exactly 10 'Future n:' lines, Future 1 = the scenario run's title, and no REWRITE id. Add a case where the scenario stub repeats Future 1 twice, so a rewrite parent's alternative ends FAILED ALTERNATIVE_NOT_DISTINCT.
findings.resolution: Round 2: AlternativeOfRewriteIT.theWindowOfTenKeepsTheScenarioRunAsFuture1WhenItIsTheOldestOfManyEligibleRuns seeds 11 COMPLETED runs with final_attempt on p's session/pack at p.created_at + k*100us (deterministic order, fresh session per test), rewrites p and asserts the exact list [Future 1: Stub future A, Future 2..10: Seeded future 3..11]. Discriminates: without coalesce (Future 1 = rewrite id, not found) the window would be Seeded 2..11; a window of 11 fails hasSize(10); chronological trimming would drop p. aCandidateThatRepeatsTheScenarioRunTwiceFailsAsNotDistinct (STANDARD / ALTERNATIVE scenario run) asserts FAILED ALTERNATIVE_NOT_DISTINCT, INITIAL + ALTERNATIVE_DISTINCT, the exact duplicate-future block with 'same future event title as future 1'; the ALTERNATIVE case discriminates the coalesce (wrong Future 1 would be Stub future A, title mismatch). Matches story-rewrite.md step-4a pipeline rules.

findings.problem: The spec says the label is chosen by profileId alone and the stored mode is not re-checked. No case stores a cross-mode selection (e.g. {"mode":"OFFICIAL","profileId":"kafka"}) to prove the mode is ignored. The code (StyleLabels.style) does ignore it.
findings.fix: Add one LabelCase 'cross-mode stored' with styleJson("OFFICIAL", "kafka") -> KAFKA.

findings.problem: The class Javadoc still says 'the parent first'. For a REWRITE parent, Future 1 is now the rewrite's scenarioRunId, not the parent. The variable name `parentId` is misleading for the same reason.
findings.fix: Rename `parentId` to `future1RunId`. Update the Javadoc: 'Future 1 = coalesce(parent.scenario_run_id, parent.id)'.
